biome_inheritance.name: What a form leaves room for
biome_inheritance.description: Standalone bridge: a primitive encounter's five panel records constrain actual BiomeObject ground cover. Candidate identities remain fixed as the panels widen. Full-size comparison, no in-world interface. Geometry-based occupancy; no growth simulation.
biome_inheritance.qfep_connection: A continuous change in one form crosses discrete occupancy thresholds for other bodies. The clearance rule and excluded candidate identities are recorded, making the chosen norm inspectable.
interactions: Observe narrow and wide panels on the same terrain; compare which cover members can stand.
